guarantees.claim: On posedge clk_i, if rst_ni is low, idle_q is reset to prim_mubi_pkg::MuBi4False; otherwise idle_q takes the value of idle_d.

assumptions.claim: idle_d must present a legal multi-bit encoded value (MuBi4) at every posedge clk_i where rst_ni is high.
assumptions.risk: Storing an illegal encoding in idle_q may corrupt downstream multi-bit logic, potentially causing silent control misbehavior.

assumptions.claim: rst_ni is an active‑low asynchronous reset, properly synchronized and glitch‑free.
assumptions.risk: Glitches or metastability on rst_ni could cause incorrect initialization or corruption of idle_q.

uncertain_points.claim: The register stores idle_d without checking whether it is a legal MuBi4 encoding; an illegal value would propagate to idle_q and downstream logic.
uncertain_points.cond: idle_d driven from logic that may produce illegal encodings (e.g., due to errors or uninitialized logic)
uncertain_points.risk: A corrupted idle signal could violate HMAC security state (e.g., indicate idle while a secret operation is in progress) or cause incorrect access control.
